title: Not That Good
text:
I thought the app was going to be excellent. The installation was easy. Setting up your signature in the app was easy too. The problem was that my signature was very faint after I saved it. And it was just as faint when I added to the document on
My iPad. I just different pens and even a broad felt tip magic marker. It was just as faint as with a pen. And my signature with the marker was as thin and narrow as the pen I used. I thought it would have been thicker and darker. That was after I followed the directions to use a sheet of blank white paper.
